dog.description_text:
At almost 6 weeks old and just 4.3 pounds, Peanut is a tiny bundle of sweetness with a whole lot of love to give! ❤️
This precious girl has been in foster care since she was just ONE DAY OLD, surrounded by love, snuggles, and plenty of spoiling!
💕 Peanut is blind, but don't let that fool you! She may experience the world differently, but she has every opportunity to live a happy, full, and wonderful life!
Peanut needs a family willing to offer a safe, predictable home, a little extra patience, and lots of love as she grows.
❤️ Peanut doesn't need your pity. She needs your LOVE!
She isn't looking for someone to feel sorry for her. She's looking for someone to fall head over heels in love with her. And trust us, that part will be EASY! 🥹🐾
🏡 Could YOU be Peanut's forever family?
dog.name: Peanut
